text: Mandatory overtime during fiscal year-end, quarterly close, and audit periods is expected; the Employee agrees to make themselves available without additional premium.
label: emp_overtime_leave_unclear

text: The probation notice period is reduced to zero days during the first four weeks; either party may terminate the relationship immediately without cause.
label: emp_probation_period_risk

text: Cost-of-living adjustments to salary are not guaranteed and are applied only when approved by the Board, at intervals determined by the Company.
label: emp_wage_payment_unclear

text: The Employer shall not be liable for delays in issuing employment verification letters, experience certificates, or settlement cheques upon termination.
label: emp_unilateral_exemption

text: During probation, the Employee must achieve a minimum attendance rate of ninety-five per cent; any shortfall, including for certified illness, may delay confirmation.
label: emp_probation_period_risk

text: The Employer disclaims liability for loss of future earnings, career progression, or professional reputation resulting from any employment decision made under this Agreement.
label: emp_unilateral_exemption

text: Bonus payments are made at the Company's absolute discretion and do not form part of contractual remuneration for the purposes of calculating notice pay or severance.
label: emp_wage_payment_unclear

text: Work performed during travel between company sites is not classified as overtime unless pre-approved in writing by the regional director.
label: emp_overtime_leave_unclear

text: Probation may be waived for senior hires at the Employer's discretion, but the Agreement does not define the criteria or process for requesting a waiver.
label: emp_probation_period_risk

text: The Employee accepts that the Employer's disciplinary record-keeping system is authoritative, and disputes over accuracy must be resolved through the Company's internal process.
label: emp_unilateral_exemption

text: Payment of the annual increment is conditional upon the Company achieving a minimum revenue target, which is not disclosed to the Employee in advance.
label: emp_wage_payment_unclear

text: The Employee is required to complete a mandatory handover period of up to four weeks upon resignation, during which annual leave may not be taken.
label: emp_overtime_leave_unclear

text: A mentor is assigned during probation whose subjective assessment carries fifty per cent of the final probation score; the mentoring relationship is not governed by any written protocol.
label: emp_probation_period_risk

text: The Employer is not obligated to provide a written statement of reasons for non-renewal of a fixed-term contract that expires during or immediately after probation.
label: emp_probation_period_risk

text: Hazard pay for dangerous assignments is calculated using an internal risk matrix that is not shared with the Employee and may be revised without notice.
label: emp_wage_payment_unclear

text: The Employee agrees to waive any and all claims that may arise from algorithmic or AI-based performance scoring used by the Employer during the employment relationship.
label: emp_unilateral_exemption

text: Shift-swap requests must be approved by management and are not guaranteed; denied swaps do not entitle the Employee to additional pay or alternative rest days.
label: emp_overtime_leave_unclear

text: The Employee's right to accrue seniority-based benefits is suspended during probation and does not resume retroactively upon confirmation.
label: emp_probation_period_risk

text: The Company may reduce the Employee's working hours and proportionally reduce salary at any time by providing fourteen days' notice, without requiring the Employee's agreement.
label: emp_wage_payment_unclear

text: Garden leave during the notice period is at the Employer's discretion; the Employee may be required to continue working or be placed on leave with no choice in the matter.
label: emp_overtime_leave_unclear

text: The probation period applies separately to each skill or competency area; the Employee must pass all areas independently, and failure in one area results in overall failure.
label: emp_probation_period_risk

text: The Employee agrees that the Employer's interpretation of any ambiguous clause in this Agreement shall prevail in the event of a dispute.
label: emp_unilateral_exemption

text: The Employer may require the Employee to take annual leave during factory shutdown periods, which may consume the majority of the Employee's annual entitlement.
label: emp_overtime_leave_unclear

text: The Employee's salary is benchmarked against undisclosed market data, and any perceived disparity does not constitute grounds for a formal pay review.
label: emp_wage_payment_unclear

label: emp_probation_period_risk
